resources.string: The game is still running in the background. Exiting closes it, and unsaved progress is lost.

The port was made by “SansNope” with the help of the Anthropic model “Opus 5.5”.

A separate HUGE thank you to “ITSeny” for a big contribution to the project. Thanks to ITSeny's help, UnleashedRecomp-Android was brought to a polished state (he really did a lot, believe us). And thanks to his huge contribution, development of MarathonRecomp-Android went 10 times faster.

Also a huge thank you to every player who tests the port and sends feedback!

We are happy to use new technologies to give many people the chance to play these games on their mobile devices.

The app icon was taken from GameBanana; it was made by “GSNReboot”.

This is an unofficial Android port of another project from GitHub, MarathonRecomp: https://github.com/sonicnext-dev/MarathonRecomp
